claims.text: The patient is recorded as allergic to amoxicillin.
A rash developed on day three of a course of treatment.

citations.quote: developed a rash on day three of the course

claims.text: A clinician note from 2026-05-02 states no known drug allergies.
Blood pressure and weight were recorded, but no values are given in the note.

open_questions: Which medication course the rash on day three was attributed to, and whether it was stopped or completed, is not stated.
When the amoxicillin allergy was first recorded and the exact reaction documented beyond 'rash' is not stated.
When the rash first appeared in absolute dates and how it was treated or resolved is not documented.
Whether the earlier 'No known drug allergies' note was ever updated, and by whom, is not documented.
No antihistamines, steroids or other medications for the rash are recorded.
No follow-ups, referrals or tests are recorded as planned or outstanding.
The actual blood pressure and weight values, and any earlier measurements, are not in the record.
The record contains no medication start, stop, hold or change list to answer the medication-change question.

candidate_highlights.risk_reason: Amoxicillin allergy recorded, but an earlier clinician note states no known drug allergies.
candidate_highlights.suggested_action: Review and reconcile the allergy list, confirming the amoxicillin reaction documentation.
